description: This file defines types, constants, and functions related to managing typing modes and signaling in a chat application, including resolving typing modes based on context and creating signaling mechanisms for different typing events.

methods.name: resolveTypingMode
methods.description: Determines the appropriate TypingMode based on the provided context, such as chat type, mentions, heartbeat, and typing policy.

methods.name: createTypingSignaler
methods.description: Creates a TypingSignaler object with methods to signal different typing events based on the mode and context.
